name: Open Interpreter
summary: Open-source agent that runs code on your computer.
description: Open Interpreter lets you control your computer in plain language: the AI writes and runs code locally to work with files, data, the browser or apps. It works with cloud or local models.
features: AI for AI agents at openinterpreter.com.

howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.
